description: National Physical Planning Department- Town and Country Planning Ordinance (Chapter 269) Warakagoda Gallen Rajamaha Viharaya
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land matters, specifically declaring the "Warakagoda Gallen Raja Maha Vihara Sacred Area" as an urban development area and directing the preparation of an outline physical plan. It includes detailed land descriptions, boundaries, and extents (8.3481 Hectares with specific lot divisions), making it clearly a Land Gazette under Type 4 classification.
